label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my sweet long-time ladies,

Please pass this around in your group texts and emails. My phone is ringing nonstop and everybody is asking the same question, so here is the whole story.

Last night—Sunday, Nov. 8, around 2 a.m.—a lady’s car came through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. Nobody was inside. The driver is okay. Police came, and her insurance will pay. Thank God nobody was hurt. I had a little cry in the morning, but I am okay now.

We have been open 11 years, and this is the first time a car wanted a pedicure. The front glass is gone, and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair—like she wanted the spa. My daughter said she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. My husband looked at the floor and said, “Finally, the shop is modern art.” Honestly, the floor looks like a rainbow threw up. We have to laugh a little.

The city inspector must check the wall before we can open. Our contractor says we can reopen Monday, Nov. 16. I will confirm when it is final.

This week, me, Trang, and Kim are working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar. If you need your nails done, call or text my cell: 832-555-0147. I can tell you where to find us.

Your gift cards are still good. Nobody will lose money. Thank you for all the texts, calls, and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning—so sweet.

Please don’t worry about me. God protected us because nobody was inside. Laugh a little with me, and I will see you soon. I will let everyone know as soon as Lotus Glow Nails is open again.

With love,
[Your name]
Lotus Glow Nails, Bellaire Blvd.
